# crosswork_topology_discovery_settings (Resource)

This resource can manage the link discovery protocols of the topology.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_topology_discovery_settings" "example" {
  lldp = true
  cdp  = true
  lag  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cdp` (Boolean) Discover the links of CDP
  - Default value: `false`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `lag` (Boolean) Discover the links of LAG
  - Default value: `false`
- `lldp` (Boolean) Discover the links of LLDP
  - Default value: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_topology_discovery_settings.example "topology_discovery_settings"
```
